newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japanese net foreign bond buyers in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Japanese net foreign bond buyers in 1996.

text.p: Net purchases of foreign bonds by Japanese investors totalled 8.3973 trillion yen in 1996 after net purchases of 7.814 trillion yen a year earlier, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Monday.
Bonds include beneficiary certificates but exclude all bills.
Net buying of Japanese stocks by foreign investors amounted to 5.1083 trillion yen in 1996 compared with net buying of 4.6310 billion yen in the previous year, the ministry said.
